name: Michael Chachere
bio: Michael Chachere is a real-life police sergeant for St. Bernard Parish, Louisiana. He appears as himself in Primetime (2026, dir. Lance Oppenheim), playing a Murphy officer who writes to the show. He is credited under his real name.  His filmography includes: Primetime (2026) (Robert Pattinson, Merritt Wever, Skyler Gisondo, Matthew Maher, Phoebe Bridgers). TV (self): The Pet Cemetery Murders: A Ghost Story, 90 Day Fiancé.

credits.title: Primetime
credits.overview: In 2006, To Catch a Predator host Chris Hansen sets out to make television history. When a high stakes operation goes fatally wrong, his veneered dream of fame curdles into a nightmare of performative justice.
